title: The Opportune Moment to Rescue Chen Nian
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was preparing a flawless plan with two parallel lines of action, a secret letter from the Holy Sect completely disrupted his deployment—Chen Nian's location had been moved ahead of schedule.

text.content: The dying words of the betrayer were like a fine needle, piercing deep into Chen Ji's heart. Mo Xiansheng—the existence who guarded the Tianji Record with a remnant soul, the enigma who knew all truths yet only spoke what should be spoken—actually had inextricable connections with the mastermind behind the scenes? This was more chilling than a mere enemy, because he had never doubted Mo Xiansheng's stance.

dialogue.content: (From the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out leisurely) "You have finally discovered it. This master has waited for this day for a very long time." In that remnant soul's voice, there was even a trace of relief, as if laying down some heavy burden.

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the tumultuous waves in his heart, his expression remaining usual. He knew Mo Xiansheng was observing him, and he knew that any loss of composure at this moment could become a handle to be gripped in the future. But he truly needed answers, even if these answers might lead him to utter destruction.

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng, have you been lurking by my side for so many years just to wait for me to discover the truth, or to wait for me to bring about my own downfall?" Chen Ji's voice betrayed neither joy nor anger, only the corners of his mouth slightly raised, forming a sarcastic curve.

"Both and neither." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a sigh, "Those chosen by the Tianji Record are never heaven-chosen ones, but those selected by the Tianji Record as chessboards. Both you and I are within it."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was digesting the meaning of these words, a gentle knock came from the door. Su Qingyao's voice came through the door, cold and clear yet carrying a rare urgency: "Chen Ji, there's news."

Chen Ji collected his thoughts, temporarily pressing the matter of Mo Xiansheng into the depths of his heart. He was too skilled at this—hiding the tumultuous waves beneath a calm lake surface. Su Qingyao pushed open the door and entered, a Jade Slip tightly clutched in her hand, her expression complex.

dialogue.content: "I used all the hidden agents my family has in the Holy Sect." Su Qingyao handed him the Jade Slip, her voice carrying a trace of exhaustion, "The location where your sister is imprisoned, I've found it. In the core area of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, three levels below the Heavenly Fate Altar."

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, his spiritual sense probing in. After a moment, his pupils slightly contracted—there were three layers of prohibition beneath the altar, each requiring a Nascent Soul cultivator to break. This meant he needed the assistance of at least two Nascent Soul experts.

However, what was even more troublesome was that the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds' defensive formation would monitor intruders' Spiritual Energy fluctuations in real-time. Unless someone could conceal it with Demonic Path mist, any approach would trigger the alarm. And the only person in this world who could manifest Demonic Path mist was Ye Qing.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji had to make a choice within limited time—whether to rescue his sister first, or to obtain the fourth page of the Tianji Record to enhance his strength first?

choices.description: The sister's safety brooks no delay, every moment of waiting means she suffers more. The fourth page of the Tianji Record can be obtained later.
choices.visible_cost: Abandoning the Optimal Timing to Obtain the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Without the Fourth Page's complete Foresight Ability, Rescue Risks Greatly Increased

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the Jade Slip tightly, a trace of determination flickering in his eyes. His sister had been missing for many years, he could wait, but Chen Nian in the Holy Sect's dungeon might not be able to wait.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su, help me contact Ye Qing." Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried unwavering determination, "Tell her that this Chen has a deal to discuss with her."

choices.description: The power contained in the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record is crucial. With complete Foresight Ability, the success rate of the rescue plan will greatly increase.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian Suffering Greater Hardship in the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining Complete Foresight Ability, Foreseeing All Variables During the Rescue
choices.risk_hint: Every Day Delayed, Chen Nian's Danger Increases

text.content: Chen Ji slipped the Jade Slip into his sleeve, a flash of pain flickering across his eyes before being quickly suppressed by rationality. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath—to ensure everything went smoothly, he had to become stronger first.

dialogue.content: "Sister Su," Chen Ji opened his eyes, his voice hoarse, "Give me three more days. In three days, I will definitely go rescue her."

text.content: Su Qingyao gazed at the fleeting struggle in Chen Ji's eyes and felt an inexplicable ache in her heart. She had never seen this ever-composed youth display such an expression—so it turned out he could also be afraid, could also waver.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji," Su Qingyao spoke softly, her voice carrying a tenderness she had never shown before, "Whatever decision you make, I will support you. This is what I owe you."

text.content: That night, Ye Qing arrived as promised. The Demonic Path Saintess's figure emerged from the shadows, her black dress accentuating her snow-white skin, though an inescapable melancholy lingered in her brows. When she saw Chen Ji, the corners of her lips lifted slightly.

dialogue.content: "Young Master Chen, it's been a while." Ye Qing's voice was like a nightingale's low trill, pleasant yet tinged with chill, "I hear you have a deal to discuss with me? Let's hear it—what deal is worthy of your words?"

Chen Ji got straight to the point. He laid out everything: Chen Nian's location, the conditions to break the triple seals, and his rescue plan. Finally, he stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes: "I need your Demonic Path Mist."

text.content: After hearing everything, Ye Qing fell silent for a moment. Her fingers tapped lightly on the table, producing a rhythmic sound. Finally, she raised her head, a hint of cunning flickering in her eyes.

dialogue.content: "The Demonic Path Mist, I can give you." Ye Qing's voice carried a trace of a smile, "But I have one condition—the intelligence about the Holy Sect's sacrifice. I want to know what they are scheming. We share it."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's condition left Chen Ji deep in thought—sharing sacrifice intelligence meant handing some of his cards to an ally, but if he refused, the rescue plan would be impossible to execute.

choices.description: Intelligence can be investigated again, but my sister cannot wait. Moreover, sharing intelligence with Ye Qing would further deepen mutual trust and cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: "Share the sacrifice intelligence with Ye Qing"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the Demonic Path Mist, the rescue plan can commence"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing might use the intelligence to profit in other areas"

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest. He extended his right hand, his slender fingers curling in the air as if grasping some invisible contract.

dialogue.content: "Deal." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, "Your reputation, Saintess Ye, I still trust. After all, we're蚂蚱 on the same rope."

choices.description: Ye Qing's intelligence network spans the Holy Sect, and her asking price is far below what she can provide. Chen Ji decides to probe her bottom line.
choices.visible_cost: "Might provoke Ye Qing, negotiations break down"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the Demonic Path Mist at a lower cost"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing's personality is fierce; if negotiations collapse, it might affect future cooperation"

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head lightly, a hint of amusement flickering in his eyes. Business is war, and he was all too familiar with the art of the negotiation table.

dialogue.content: "Saintess Ye's condition is a bit high." Chen Ji spoke unhurriedly, "I can give you the sacrifice intelligence, but I also want your layout map of the Holy Sect's internal defenses. As an exchange, I'll tell you a secret about your identity—the true cause of your mother's death."

Upon hearing this, Ye Qing's pupils suddenly contracted. The moment Chen Ji mentioned her mother, she felt as if she had been seen through completely. This man knew far more than she had ever imagined.

text.content: A moment later, Ye Qing let out a light laugh, her smile carrying a hint of complexity. She stood up, her black skirt sweeping through the air in an elegant arc. 'Chen Ji, you really are someone one both loves and hates.'

dialogue.content: 'Alright, I agree.' Ye Qing's voice carried a touch of resolve, 'But the defensive formation maps must be given to me in batches, and you must give me half of the sacrifice intelligence first. This is my bottom line.'

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, extending his hand. Two palms met in mid-air—one belonging to a nameless good-for-nothing servant, the other to the peerless Saint Maiden of the Holy Sect. This single handshake altered the fates of countless souls.

dialogue.content: 'Then, three days from now, I'll meet you at the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds.' Chen Ji released her hand, a faint smile tugging at his lips. 'Saint Ye, I hope you won't disappoint me.'
Ye Qing turned to leave, but at the threshold, she suddenly paused and glanced back at Chen Ji. 'Chen Ji, about my mother... if you deceive me, I will make you regret being born into this world.'

text.content: Chen Ji offered no response, merely watching her silhouette fade into the night. Only after confirming she had truly gone did he slowly speak, his voice barely above a whisper, as if talking to himself: 'Mo Xiansheng, tell me... who else can I trust?'

From the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted out: 'Trust is the most extravagant luxury in the cultivation world. Yet sometimes, the most perilous path requires a companion to walk it.' As his words faded, Chen Ji suddenly felt a sharp pain in his heart. He spun around sharply, only to find Su Qingyao still standing there, moonlight washing over her face, revealing a complex expression.

The night breeze brushed past, stirring Su Qingyao's hair. She suddenly spoke softly, her voice carrying an unprecedented fragility: 'Chen Ji, have you ever thought... if one day I stand against you, what would you do?' Chen Ji froze, then smiled. He walked over to Su Qingyao and gently brushed a falling leaf from her shoulder. 'Senior Sister Su, you won't.' His voice was soft, yet carried absolute certainty. 'Because you are Su Qingyao.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stared at him blankly, the young man's face beneath the moonlight serene and profound, as if concealing a universe of stars. She suddenly felt like crying, yet couldn't understand what she was grieving for.

text.content: Yet on this very night, when Chen Ji believed everything was in place, a secret letter from the Holy Sect silently appeared on his desk. The message contained only a single line, yet it made Chen Ji's face turn deathly pale—'Chen Nian is no longer in position, dear Chessmaster.'

Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly. This was the second time in his life he felt true terror—the first when he learned his sister had been taken, and now upon discovering his enemies had long seen through all his plans. He took a deep breath, crushing the letter into powder, a cold ruthlessness flickering in his eyes that had never been there before. Holy Sect... very well. Since you want to play, then I'll play this game until the very end.
